title: VUA inspection.list (v0.1)
description: Identity listing over inspection evidence runs, newest first: entries are ordered by performedAt descending (RFC 3339 UTC same-shape strings order lexicographically = chronologically; the declared-before-implementation discipline, same face as production-use-case recipe.list 'updatedAt descending' and the core overlay production_card newest-first precedent). FROZEN v0.1 (proposal 016 arbitration point 2: independent vocabulary row, get/list after the record.get/list precedent; freeze batch 2026-09-13, data role): the freeze hard-preconditions are closed — (1) the production M7 anchor slice landed and accepted (Bridge v3 five-dimension producing operations, c33adb3 → 7d63abe); (2) the core-side store, the read routes (this face implemented verbatim) and the task-driven inspection.requestRun landed and accepted (merge 7a262b8), followed by the data-review revision batch (c914cf2: family-owned INSPECTION_QUERIES_SCHEMA_VERSION unifies the three family replies — ratified by the data role); (3) positive/negative vectors green plus consumer tests in-tree (acquisition inspection_queries_contract + provider-host frame loop); (4) the bilingual protocol document and (5) the docs/REGISTRY.md row land with this freeze batch. Filters stay minimal and honest: exact-match avatarRef (the namespaced identity or explicit scene path carried by the evidence body — no fuzzy text filter is invented), overallStatus closed set, offset paging with a bounded limit. Entries are identity summary rows: the dimensions and checks stay in the evidence body — the list never inlines them (reference, do not copy, 012 evidenceIds discipline).

inspectionId.description: VUA-generated inspection identity (uuid v7), same identity convention as the inspection-evidence body schema.

avatarRef.description: Exact-match filter on the evidence body's avatarRef.ref value (a namespaced identity such as warehouse:<itemId>, a project-scoped avatar id, or an explicit scene path — verbatim identity, never a guess).

overallStatus.description: Filter on the aggregated status carried by the evidence body (proposal 016 §4 rule: fail > warn [including unavailable] > pass).

entry.description: Identity summary row. Deliberately narrow: no dimensions, no checks — the honest detail lives in the evidence body, reachable via inspection.get.

avatarRef.description: The evidence body's avatarRef, transcribed verbatim (ref required, label optional — same shape as the body schema).

performedAt.description: When the inspection run was executed (RFC 3339, transcribed from the evidence body). The list ordering key.
